Default Safeguard baseline emissions intensity trajectory

Source: R/safeguard_reform.R
cer_safeguard_baseline_trajectory.Rd

Returns the baseline emissions intensity, per unit of a production variable, for a facility whose baseline is set at the default emissions intensity in Schedule 1 of the Safeguard Mechanism Rule 2015 and the default emissions reduction contribution (ERC) in section 31:

Usage

cer_safeguard_baseline_trajectory(industry, from_year = 2023, to_year = 2030)

Arguments

industry

Character scalar: a production_variable from cer_safeguard_industry_baselines() (case-insensitive), or its Schedule 1 section number, e.g. "7" for aluminium.

from_year

Start year (default 2023 for FY 2023-24).

to_year

End year (default 2030 for FY 2030-31).

Value

A data frame with year, financial_year, default_emissions_intensity, decline_factor (the default ERC) and baseline (t CO2-e per unit of the production variable).

Details

$$B_t = EI \times ERC_t$$

where ERC is 0.951 for FY 2023-24 and falls by 0.049 a year (a linear decline of 4.9 percent of the default intensity) to 0.657 for FY 2029-30, then by 0.03285 a year, never below zero. Facilities using site-specific emissions intensities, and trade-exposed baseline-adjusted facilities (see cer_safeguard_teba_facilities()), have different baselines.

References

Commonwealth of Australia. National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting (Safeguard Mechanism) Rule 2015 (F2015L01637), compilation of 31 August 2024: sections 31 to 33 and Schedule 1.

See also

Other safeguard: cer_safeguard_facilities(), cer_safeguard_industry_baselines(), cer_safeguard_teba_facilities()

Examples

cer_safeguard_baseline_trajectory("Aluminium")
cer_safeguard_baseline_trajectory("63", from_year = 2023, to_year = 2035)
